title: Carlyle’s Thomas: AI Slowdown ‘More Likely Than Not’
summary: Carlyle Head of Global Research & Investment Strategy Jason Thomas spoke with Bloomberg’s Dani Burger from the sidelines of Carlyle’s Global Investor Conference in Washington. He also talked about the AI investment boom, saying an AI slowdown is “more likely than not.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dubai Corporation for Tourism & Commerce Marketing CEO
summary:
Bloomberg Television's Abeer Abu Omar speaks exclusively with Issam Kazim, CEO of Dubai Corporation for Tourism and Commerce Marketing, at the Arabian Travel Market. He observes that Dubai has become a "mature" city, with people now wanting to come to the region for a holiday or for residency, whereas it was previously a stopover destination. He says competition between regional players in the UAE is "healthy" and important for attracting talent.
